title: Bank Deposit Recall Fee Charge
content:
The recall fee charged on a Bank Deposit recall request is the listed recall fee of the transfer's tier, charged in full and rounded half up to the cent.

## Terms

- **Listed recall fee.** The recall fee the transfer's Bank Deposit tier lists in its tier terms.
- **In full.** The customer pays 100 percent of that amount.
- **Rounding.** The fee is rounded half up to the cent once, on the final amount charged.
- **Currency.** The fee is in US dollars.

## Worked example (hypothetical figure)

On a tier whose listed recall fee were 12.50 US dollars, the recall fee charged would be 100 percent of 12.50, that is 12.50.

| Listed recall fee (hypothetical) | Share charged | Recall fee |
|---|---|---|
| 12.50 | 100 percent | 12.50 |
| 20.00 | 100 percent | 20.00 |
